Proposals.Development: The party successfully executes the plan to confront Skrit Ironjaw using the captives as leverage. Elias projects authority from the gallery, forcing Skrit to surrender his weapon and command structure without a full-scale melee. The goblins are bound and neutralized, and the party secures the exit route while managing the physical toll of carrying injured allies (Hobb, Nella) up the stairs.
Proposals.Evidence: "Skrit," he called out. "I know you are in there."
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: The party has secured the keep, neutralized the goblin band and their leader, and is exiting with the captives. The immediate rescue objective is complete; the next phase involves returning to the village.
Proposals.ProposedNextMilestone: Return to the village to complete the contract.
